description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginFailed" name="Login failed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="T_Login" targetRef="SStart_Login"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful" sourceRef="SendLoginOK" targetRef="ICE_LoginOK"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginFailed" name="Login failed" sourceRef="SendLoginFail" targetRef="ICE_LoginFail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" sourceRef="T_Submit" targetRef="ICE_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed" sourceRef="Throw_Completed" targetRef="ICE_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CStart_Shopping" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="T_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop system"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EBG_Login" name="Login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_LoginOK" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginOK" messageRef="Msg_LoginSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_LoginFail" name="Login failed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginFail" messageRef="Msg_LoginFailed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ProductMerge" name="Next product"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="T_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="T_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="CF_AllSelected_Yes"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T_Submit" name="Submit order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_CustSplit" name="Start payment and address"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_BillingQuestion" name="Shipping address equals billing address?" default="CF_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterBilling" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AddressMerge" name="Address completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_CustJoin" name="Payment and address completed"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Throw_Completed" name="Address and payment completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Completed" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerDone" name="Order details submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_01" sourceRef="CStart_Shopping" targetRef="T_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_02" sourceRef="T_Login" targetRef="EBG_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_03" sourceRef="EBG_Login" targetRef="ICE_LoginOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_04" sourceRef="EBG_Login" targetRef="ICE_LoginFail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_05" sourceRef="ICE_LoginOK" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_06" sourceRef="GW_ProductMerge" targetRef="T_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_07" sourceRef="ICE_LoginFail" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_08" sourceRef="T_SelectProduct" targetRef="T_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_09" sourceRef="T_AddToCart" targetRef="T_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_10" sourceRef="T_SaveProduct" targetRef="T_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_11" sourceRef="T_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="GW_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_AllSelected_No" name="No" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_AllSelected_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="T_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_12" sourceRef="T_Submit" targetRef="GW_CustSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_13" sourceRef="GW_CustSplit" targetRef="T_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_14" sourceRef="GW_CustSplit" targetRef="T_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_15" sourceRef="T_EnterPayment" targetRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_16" sourceRef="ICE_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="GW_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_17" sourceRef="T_EnterShipping" targetRef="GW_BillingQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_BillingDiffers" name="No" sourceRef="GW_BillingQuestion" targetRef="T_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffersFromShipping == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_BillingSame" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_BillingQuestion" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_18" sourceRef="T_EnterBilling" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_19" sourceRef="GW_AddressMerge" targetRef="GW_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_20" sourceRef="GW_CustJoin" targetRef="Throw_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_21" sourceRef="Throw_Completed" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SStart_Login" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SStartLogin" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?" default="SF_CredFail"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendLoginOK" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendLoginFail" name="Send login failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="SEnd_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_SysSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_SysJoin" name="Preparations completed"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_Completed" name="Address and payment completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SysCompleted" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="SEnd_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="SStart_Login" targetRef="T_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="T_CheckCredentials" targetRef="GW_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CredOK" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendLoginOK">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CredFail" name="No" sourceRef="GW_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendLoginFail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="SendLoginOK" targetRef="ICE_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="SendLoginFail" targetRef="SEnd_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="ICE_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="T_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" sourceRef="T_FinishOrder" targetRef="GW_SysSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="GW_SysSplit" targetRef="T_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="GW_SysSplit" targetRef="T_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" sourceRef="T_PreparePayment" targetRef="GW_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" sourceRef="T_PrepareShipment" targetRef="GW_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" sourceRef="GW_SysJoin" targetRef="ICE_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" sourceRef="ICE_Completed" targetRef="T_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="T_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="SEnd_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
